label: Client Brief
title: Understanding the story you need told.
description: A short call or brief to pin down audience, tone, deadline, and deliverables before a single clip is touched.

label: Planning
title: Structuring the edit before the timeline opens.
description: Footage is logged, selects are marked, and a rough structure is mapped so the first cut has direction, not guesswork.

label: Editing
title: Building rhythm, pace, and narrative flow.
description: The assembly becomes a story — cuts land on beats, pacing tightens, and the piece finds its shape.

label: Color Grading
title: Giving every frame a consistent mood.
description: Exposure, contrast, and tone are matched shot to shot in DaVinci Resolve for a unified, cinematic look.

label: Sound Design
title: Mixing dialogue, music, and texture.
description: Levels are balanced, music is scored to picture, and small foley details are layered in so the piece feels alive.

label: Motion Graphics
title: Adding titles, transitions, and polish.
description: Type, logos, and graphic transitions are animated in After Effects to match the pacing already set.

label: Delivery
title: Exporting, reviewing, and handing it off.
description: Final files are rendered to spec for every platform, with two rounds of revisions built in before delivery.
